tests: A realistic three-page report combining most of the corpus's individual attacks: an inverted heading hierarchy, a note row above a table header, a ruled and a borderless table with captions below, two captioned figures, a description list with a doubled definition, a footnote, a vector ornament, and a logo repeating in a brand bar.
attacks: All of the above at once, in a document that looks entirely ordinary.
